verdict.rationale: The docs have a dedicated languages page with a table of ISO 639-1 codes (e.g., en, es), and the job-create docs say language is auto-detected per segment when none is given. That delivers the concrete published list. Nothing in the pack says whether coverage differs per model or per feature, even though a separate faster edge-transcription mode for 'supported' short-audio workflows exists. Missing for 10: per-model/per-feature language differences (e.g., edge transcription, diarization, auto-detection coverage), visibility into the actual list contents and size, independent corroboration.
